description: Source code for 'mod_limit', a module that limits concurrent connections or requests per second in the lighttpd 2 web server. Implements connection/request counting, IP-based limits, and associated actions.

classes.name: mod_limit_context
classes.description: Represents the context for connection/request limiting, including type, limit, mutex, plugin, action, and pool data.

classes.name: mod_limit_req_ip_data
classes.description: Holds per-IP request count, timeout element, IP address, and associated context for IP-based request limiting.

classes.name: mod_limit_data
classes.description: Contains per-worker timeout queues for managing request timeouts.

methods.name: mod_limit_context_new
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new mod_limit_context with specified type, limit, action, and plugin.

methods.name: mod_limit_context_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a mod_limit_context, including mutex and radix trees.

methods.name: mod_limit_timeout_callback
methods.description: Callback invoked when a waitqueue timeout occurs; removes IP entries and frees associated data.

methods.name: mod_limit_vrclose
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a virtual request is closed; decrements connection counts and frees context if needed.

methods.name: mod_limit_action_handle
methods.description: Main handler for connection/request limiting; enforces limits, executes actions, or returns 503.

methods.name: mod_limit_action_free
methods.description: Frees the reference to a mod_limit_context when no longer needed.

methods.name: mod_limit_action_create
methods.description: Creates a new action for limiting, with specified type and configuration value.

methods.name: mod_limit_action_con_ip_create
methods.description: Creates an IP-based connection limit action.

methods.name: mod_limit_action_req_create
methods.description: Creates a request per second limit action.

methods.name: mod_limit_action_req_ip_create
methods.description: Creates an IP-based request per second limit action.

methods.name: plugin_limit_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the plugin, including timeout queues.

methods.name: plugin_limit_init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, setting options, actions, and handlers.

methods.name: mod_limit_init
methods.description: Registers the mod_limit plugin with the server.
